test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to 2011 Census, which among the following state has the highest population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India, with 199,581,477 people as of 1 March 2011. Hence, Option 4 is correct.
 
• The state contributes 16.16 percent of India's population
 
• The population density is 828 people per square kilometer, making it one of the most densely populated states in the country
 
• The sex ratio in 2011 was 908 women to 1000 men, lower than the national figure
